verdict.rationale: Render documents an official MCP server that lets compatible AI apps such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor manage Render infrastructure. Changelog entries show it is actively developed, adding a trigger_deploy tool and OAuth-based authentication for agent clients. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Render's Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables you to manage your Render infrastructure directly from compatible AI apps, such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex Desktop, Codex CLI, and Cursor
The Render MCP server now includes a `trigger_deploy` tool that enables you (and your agents) to kick off a new deploy of an existing service.
The Render MCP server now supports OAuth-based authentication for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor
